sin.name: shell-input-rewritten-outside-the-runner-effect
sin.description: An effect other than the processes module's RunnerStartEffect gives the tool a new input, so two effects compete for a shell line and the line may skip the runner.
sin.rule: RunnerStartEffect alone answers input_after for a shell line; a managed hook's own replacement input comes in through ProjectHookTransform, and every other contribution answers with lines, a refusal or commands.
